description: Defines the QboneClientSession class, a specialized QUIC session for Qbone over the quiche library, including methods for session management, packet processing, and proof handling.

classes.name: QboneClientSession
classes.description: A QUIC session class for Qbone, handling cryptographic handshake, control stream creation, and packet processing.

methods.name: QboneClientSession
methods.description: Constructor initializing the session with connection, config, and handler parameters.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Overrides to initiate the crypto stream.

methods.name: SetDefaultEncryptionLevel
methods.description: Overrides to set control stream at FORWARD_SECURE encryption level.

methods.name: GetNumSentClientHellos
methods.description: Returns the count of client hello messages sent.

methods.name: EarlyDataAccepted
methods.description: Checks if early data was accepted by the server.

methods.name: ReceivedInchoateReject
methods.description: Indicates if handshake was delayed due to server proof requirement.

methods.name: GetNumReceivedServerConfigUpdates
methods.description: Returns the number of server config updates received.

methods.name: SendServerRequest
methods.description: Sends a server request over the session.

methods.name: ProcessPacketFromNetwork
methods.description: Processes incoming packets from the network.

methods.name: HasActiveRequests
methods.description: Checks if there are active requests on the session.

methods.name: CreateCryptoStream
methods.description: Creates a crypto stream for the session.

methods.name: CreateControlStream
methods.description: Creates the control stream for Qbone.
